headline: Last session: Nifty gains 75 points while Sensex slips into red; indices fall for sixth straight week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following CAS adjustments during the session.
Nifty managed to gain 75 points despite overall market volatility.
Global triggers including US Fed hawkishness and oil prices weighed on sentiment.
The major indices recorded their sixth consecutive weekly decline.
whatHappening: Nifty is currently testing the critical 23,000 support zone for the week ahead.
Banking stocks are being positioned for a potential re-rating by fund managers.
Paytm remains in focus following recent market volatility and news updates.
Global markets are reacting to Warren Buffett's alarm regarding stock market valuations.
summary: The last trading session saw a mixed performance with Nifty gaining 75 points while Sensex ended in the red, marking a sixth straight weekly loss. Banking stocks are drawing investor interest for a potential re-rating despite global headwinds like Fed hawkishness and rising oil prices. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 21 September.
